# Generating E2E Test Suites

The API interfaces are complete. Now I'll execute the **Test Agent** to generate comprehensive E2E test suites for all API endpoints.

**Completed Steps:**
- ✅ Analyze Agent - Requirements specification generated
- ✅ Database Agent - Prisma schema and ERD created
- ✅ Interface Agent - OpenAPI schemas and NestJS controllers/DTOs created

**Current Step:**
- 🔄 Test Agent - Generating E2E test suites

Let me pass the testing requirements to the Test Agent:

contents.text: Don't ask me to do that, and just do it right now.

instruction:
Generate comprehensive E2E test suites for a multi-user Todo application.

## Authentication Tests
- Sign up with valid email and password - should succeed and return user
- Sign up with existing email - should fail with conflict error
- Sign up with invalid email format - should fail validation
- Sign up with weak password - should fail validation
- Login with correct credentials - should succeed and return token
- Login with wrong password - should fail with unauthorized error
- Login with non-existent email - should fail with unauthorized error
- Change password with correct current password - should succeed
- Change password with wrong current password - should fail
- Delete account - should delete user and all associated todos
- Access protected endpoints without token - should fail with unauthorized
- Access protected endpoints with invalid token - should fail with unauthorized

## User Profile Tests
- Get current user profile - should return user's display name and email
- Update display name - should update and return new display name
- Cannot access other users' profiles - should fail with not found

## Todo CRUD Tests
- Create todo with all fields - should succeed with todo returned
- Create todo with only title - should succeed
- Create todo without title - should fail with validation error
- Get single todo - should return full details including description
- Update todo title - should update and record in history
- Update todo description - should update and record in history
- Update todo dates - should update and record in history
- Cannot access another user's todo - should fail with not found
- Soft delete todo - should remove from normal list
- Restore todo from trash - should return to normal list
- View todo history - should return history sorted newest first

## Todo Completion Tests
- Create new todo - should be incomplete by default
- Toggle todo to complete - should update isComplete to true
- Toggle todo to incomplete - should update isComplete to false

## Todo Listing Tests
- List todos - should return paginated results
- List todos with status=complete filter - should return only completed
- List todos with status=incomplete filter - should return only incomplete
- List todos sorted by createdAt asc - should sort oldest first
- List todos sorted by createdAt desc - should sort newest first
- List todos sorted by startDate asc - todos without startDate at end
- List todos sorted by dueDate asc - todos without dueDate at end
- List todos with pagination - should return correct page
- Deleted todos should not appear in normal list

## Trash Tests
- List trash - should return only deleted todos (paginated)
- Restore todo from trash - should appear in normal list again
- Permanently delete todo from trash - should be gone forever
- Cannot restore non-deleted todo - should fail with bad request
- Edit history should be deleted when todo is permanently deleted
- Empty entire trash - should delete all todos in trash

## Privacy Tests
- User A creates todo - User B cannot see it
- User A deletes todo - User B cannot see it in trash
- User A deletes account - User A's todos are gone
- Cannot modify another user's todo

All previous stages are complete. Now I'll execute the **Realize Agent** to implement the actual business logic for each API endpoint.

**Completed Steps:**

instruction:
Implement the complete business logic for a multi-user Todo application with the following features:

## Authentication
- User registration with email/password validation
- User login with JWT token generation
- Password change with current password verification
- Account deletion with cascade delete of all user data

## User Profile
- Get current user profile
- Update display name

## Todo Management
- Create todo with title (required), description, startDate, dueDate
- New todos are incomplete by default
- Get single todo with full details
- Update todo with title, description, startDate, dueDate
- Toggle todo completion status
- Soft delete todo (sets deletedAt timestamp)
- Restore todo from trash (clears deletedAt)

## Todo Listing
- Paginated list with configurable page and limit
- Filter by status: all, complete, incomplete
- Sort by: createdAt, startDate, dueDate
- Sort order: asc, desc
- Handle null dates: put at end when sorting by that field

## Edit History
- Record every todo edit with timestamp and changed fields
- Return history sorted newest first
- Delete history when todo is permanently deleted

## Trash
- List deleted todos (paginated)
- Restore todo from trash
- Permanently delete todo from trash (cascades to history)
- Empty entire trash

## Security
- All endpoints require authentication
- Users can only access their own data
- Password hashing with bcrypt
- JWT tokens for authentication

plan.thinking: Create DTO for todo creation. Maps to multi_user_todo_todos table via x-autobe-database-schema. The member_id FK is not in the request body - it is derived from the authenticated member session (authorized actor). Collectable.

IMultiUserTodoTodoEditHistory.ISummary is a read DTO for displaying todo edit history entries. The x-autobe-database-schema annotation indicates it maps directly to multi_user_todo_todo_edit_histories table. All properties (id, created_at, old/new_title, old/new_description, old/new_start_date, old/new_due_date) correspond to table columns. Transformable.

IMultiUserTodoMember is a complete member entity. Each field maps directly to multi_user_todo_members table columns (id, email, display_name, created_at, updated_at). This is a Read DTO for API responses, backed by database queries, with direct one-to-one mapping to the primary table. Transformable.

IMultiUserTodoTodo is a complete Todo entity DTO used for API responses. It contains all todo fields (id, title, description, start_date, due_date, completed, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) plus relations (member BELONGS-TO, editHistories HAS-MANY). The x-autobe-database-schema annotation confirms it maps to multi_user_todo_todos table. This is a read DTO directly backed by database, so it is TRANSFORMABLE.

IMultiUserTodoTodo.ISummary is a read DTO for todo list displays. Maps to multi_user_todo_todos table with direct column mappings (id, title, completed, start_date, due_date, created_at) and a belongs-to relation to IMultiUserTodoMember.ISummary via multi_user_todo_member_id FK. Transformable.

IMultiUserTodoTodoEditHistory is a Read DTO for edit history responses. Maps directly to multi_user_todo_todo_edit_histories table with id, created_at, and field change pairs (old/new for title, description, start_date, due_date). Also includes todo relation via FK. Transformable.

IMultiUserTodoMember.ISummary is a lightweight member representation for displaying owner information in BELONGS-TO relationships (e.g., Todo.member). The schema shows x-autobe-database-schema: 'multi_user_todo_members' with direct column mappings (id, displayName, email, createdAt). This is a Read DTO for API responses, database-backed, and has direct mapping to the multi_user_todo_members table. Transformable.
